agebalanced_primary.include: 110 participants; Lying/Rest and Sitting/Rest only; 220 sessions
agebalanced_primary.post_exercise_role: predeclared stress sensitivity only; never pooled with primary or used to tune after held-out scoring
agebalanced_primary.beat_reference: R peaks derived by ecg_reference_v1; no source annotations

vs_dataset_secondary.include: 24 participants x Resting/Apnea when all source files and hashes are available
vs_dataset_secondary.hr_reference: raw Mindray ecg_lead2 after ecg_reference_v1 QC
vs_dataset_secondary.br_reference: raw Mindray respiration after rsp_reference_v1 QC
vs_dataset_secondary.beat_reference: R peaks derived by ecg_reference_v1; no source annotations
vs_dataset_secondary.role: secondary external generalization; not a substitute for AgeBalanced held-out selection

rs6240_calibration.include: only sessions with a frozen raw-to-derived manifest and verified ECG, RSP, radar and timestamp linkage
rs6240_calibration.hr_reference: raw BIOPAC ECG after ecg_reference_v1 QC
rs6240_calibration.br_reference: raw BIOPAC RSP after rsp_reference_v1 QC

dataset_rules.prohibition: A source without raw RSP cannot score BR; a source without QC-passed ECG-derived beats cannot score beat metrics; no source may score HRV while authorization.hrv=false.

participant_split.leakage_rule: all sessions and windows from one participant remain in one split
participant_split.development_use: adapter implementation, hyperparameter selection, method-specific rule development, fixed delay calibration and all other tuning before held-out scoring
participant_split.held_out_use: one-shot final head-to-head scoring for pre-registered frozen methods after all method config hashes, QC, thresholds and delay rules are frozen

windows.boundary_rule: half-open [start,end); no padding; incomplete final windows are rejected
windows.historical_equivalence: 25 s / 5 s is allowed only for labelled historical equivalence reproduction and is ineligible for candidate selection

radar_common_input.representation: decoded complex range-FFT tensor with source timestamps
operations: normalize axis order to time x channel x range_bin
crop documented physical ROI to 0.30-3.50 m
radar_common_input.method_rule: method-specific operations must be declared and config-hashed; they may not inspect ECG/RSP or held-out outcomes
radar_common_input.missing_frame_rule: no silent interpolation; reject or emit an explicit missing-input status

reference_qc.execution_order: full-session reference QC before radar scoring, then window eligibility

ecg_reference_v1.normalization: subtract median and divide by 1.4826*MAD; fail if robust scale is zero
ecg_reference_v1.peak_detector: scipy find_peaks on both polarities; choose polarity with larger median prominence; minimum distance 0.30 s; normalized prominence 0.25
ecg_reference_v1.rr_jump_rule: adjacent IBI change >20% is a flag, not an automatic deletion; automatic deletion requires physiologic-range failure or detector/morphology QC failure
ecg_reference_v1.hr_definition: 60 / median QC-passed IBI in the window

rsp_reference_v1.required_source: raw respiratory belt waveform and timestamps; accelerometer is not accepted as RSP
rsp_reference_v1.normalization: subtract median and divide by 1.4826*MAD; fail if robust scale is zero
rsp_reference_v1.peak_detector: scipy find_peaks; minimum distance 0.50 s; normalized prominence 0.20
rsp_reference_v1.cycle_jump_rule: the historical 17% adjacent-cycle rule is not used for automatic rejection
rsp_reference_v1.br_definition: 60 / median QC-passed respiratory peak interval in the window

synchronization.rate_metrics: source timestamps define identical half-open windows; no lag optimization

beat_metrics.fixed_offset: one scalar per dataset x method, estimated on development participants only as the robust median matched delay within +/-250 ms, then config-hashed and applied unchanged to held_out
beat_metrics.minimum_offset_calibration: at least 100 development matches from at least 5 participants; otherwise corrected beat scoring is BLOCKED
forbidden: using held-out ECG to revise offset

quality_strata.common_target_for_qc: maximum residual-power channel/bin inside the physical ROI after per-window complex-mean removal; used only for QC, never reference-guided
quality_strata.target_snr_db: 10*log10(target residual power / median residual power of non-adjacent ROI bins)
quality_strata.target_coherence: magnitude of the circular mean of unit phase increments for the common QC target
quality_strata.low: decoded window that fails medium but does not meet rejected criteria
quality_strata.motion: if an independent motion reference exists, motion fail forces low; not_available is retained and never silently treated as pass
quality_strata.reporting: all attempted reference-valid windows form the coverage denominator; primary errors use scored high+medium windows; high, medium, low/rejected counts are always separate

metrics.aggregation: window metrics plus participant-macro metrics; participant is the resampling cluster
metrics.confidence_intervals: participant-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20260827, percentile 95% CI

harmonic_lock.tolerance: max(3 bpm, 5% of the candidate harmonic rate)
harmonic_lock.priority: correct HR if within 3 bpm; otherwise two_x_hr, half_x_hr, resp_h2, resp_h3, resp_h4; ties are ambiguous
harmonic_lock.resp_harmonic: estimate within tolerance of k*RSP_BR for k=2,3,4 and not within 3 bpm of ECG_HR
harmonic_lock.missing_rsp: respiratory-harmonic class is NOT_ASSESSABLE, never assumed absent

algorithm_selection.eligibility: clear license/permission, reproducible source or explicit paper_reimplementation, fixed config hash, schema-valid output, G0-G2 pass; all method identity, parameters, QC, thresholds, delay rules and ranking rules must be frozen before held-out scoring
algorithm_selection.separate_endpoints: HR and BR are evaluated separately; no undocumented composite score
algorithm_selection.held_out_comparison: all pre-registered frozen methods may be scored once on the same 80 held-out participants for a final head-to-head comparison
algorithm_selection.ranking: lowest held-out participant-macro MAE among methods that satisfy the predeclared eligibility and endpoint gates
algorithm_selection.tie: if absolute macro-MAE difference <0.5 bpm/rpm and the paired participant-bootstrap 95% CI includes zero, prefer in order: existing validated implementation, clear permissive license, lower compute, fewer device assumptions
algorithm_selection.primary_confirmatory_rule: if a primary confirmatory method is required, it must be designated before held-out scoring; other frozen methods are secondary comparative benchmarks and cannot retroactively become the pre-specified primary
algorithm_selection.one_shot: held-out results may report final comparative ranking but may not trigger retuning, QC/threshold/delay changes, candidate-set changes, method revisions or ranking-rule changes; any post-heldout revision is a new development iteration and cannot reuse the same 80 participants as an untouched confirmatory test
algorithm_selection.quality_rule: a method cannot pass on high-quality windows alone; overall coverage and all quality strata must be reported

output_contract.format: JSON Lines canonical; CSV export permitted only as a lossless projection

amendment.reason: clarify held-out comparison semantics before any held-out result was generated or inspected
